experiment: Round 8: training-only loss/overlap audit and fixed sampling-policy interventions
scope: Research only. No new prices, later evaluation periods, architectures, epochs, pretraining, execution simulation or live changes. The 141 Friday validation observations in 2018-2020 have been repeatedly inspected; all results are exploratory. The unstable round-6 combined20 model is a fixed experimental instrument, not a promoted strategy.

policy_definitions.full: Reuse nine frozen combined20 full-history models and their 423 seed forecasts. All mature labeled observations, equal weight.
policy_definitions.disjoint: Three separate fixed start offsets 0,1,2 in the date-sorted full training rows. Greedily retain a row only if its entry bar is strictly after the preceding retained joint label end=max(exit bar, anchor+5), inclusive. This conservatively removes all shared future bars between return and auxiliary labels. It does not remove overlapping 125-bar inputs or imply independent observations. No best phase selection or cross-phase ensemble.
policy_definitions.quarter_equal: All mature rows, with per-row weight N/(Q*n_q), where Q is the number of observed anchor-date calendar quarters and n_q the rows in that quarter. Each quarter has equal objective mass, including partial quarters. Weights depend only on dates and eligibility, never realized volatility or loss. This equalizes calendar mass, not error contribution.
policy_definitions.recent3y: Retain mature anchors on or after January 1 of cutoff year minus 2, equal weight. Fixed three-calendar-year memory, no memory-length search. Earlier bars may still occur in 125-bar inputs.

model: Frozen research_v6.models6.make_model('combined', seed): 38551 parameters, d_model16/d_ff32, dropout0.3, two encoder layers, four heads, factor4. Raw 125-bar OHLCV normalized windows from round5; no architecture or initialization change.
objective: Training-policy weighted standardized executable weekly return MSE + 0.1 times weighted standardized five-future-bar OHLCV MSE. Return and auxiliary mean/population SD are fitted only to retained labels using policy weights; floor SD at 1e-6. For uniform policies use the identical unweighted legacy computation. Quarter weights have mean1; multiply per-row loss by its weight and take arithmetic batch mean, including the unchanged final partial batch. Do not renormalize within batch.
budget: 45 new neural fits: five new policies x three folds x three seeds, 20 epochs, final checkpoint only. Each epoch presents the full-history row count, appending fresh retained-only permutations as needed; same batch counts as the frozen full comparator. Subsets repeat more, so this isolates sample organization under a fixed optimizer budget, not reduced training work. Reuse nine full models: replay all54. Two independent workers, round-robin fit-plan shards (23 and22). No outcome-dependent extra fits.
linear_reference: 18 deterministic Ridge fits: each of six policies x three folds. Same flattened 625 raw normalized patch values, weighted training-only feature standardization and intercept; no auxiliary target or geometry features. Minimize sum_i w_i*(y_i-b-X_i beta)^2 + 10*||beta||^2 with weights summing to full-history N for every policy, so penalty mass is comparable. Alpha10 is fixed, untuned here; this is not the previously selected engineered-feature Ridge. Archive coefficients, scales and predictions. Linear comparisons are descriptive.
audit: Before new fitting, compute label interval concurrency and adjacent-return correlation, per-year/per-quarter sample and squared-loss shares, top1% loss share. Audit both training-mean baseline loss and actual frozen full combined20 fitted training losses across all nine checkpoints. Return increment support is [entry, exit); conservative joint future-bar support is [entry, max(exit,anchor+5)] inclusive. Interval concurrency describes label reuse, not independent effective sample size. Target label statistics and fitted losses here use training rows only.
primary: Ten paired weekly MSE comparisons: each of five new three-seed neural ensembles versus the frozen full neural ensemble and versus its own policy-weighted training mean. Circular bootstrap with block length8 observations, 10000 replicates, seed20260910; centered two-sided p and Holm correction across all ten. Also report percentile95% CIs, whose inversion need not equal the centered test. No phase, policy, seed or epoch is selected based on these validation results.
descriptive_screen: For each policy, report whether ensemble MSE beats full neural, its own mean and common full-history mean, AND at least two of three seeds beat own mean. This is a local exploratory consistency screen, not statistical confirmation. The disjoint family screen requires all three fixed phases to meet it; do not count the phases as independent datasets. Report corrected p values separately, plus linear controls, annual scores and input-reassignment diagnostics.
verification: Preserve hashes of all seven previous rounds. Freeze protocol, source, input, masks, weights and fit plan before training. Test interval disjointness, maturity, weight mass and repetition budget, equal-weight loss/scales/one-epoch training equality to legacy, and weighted Ridge normal equations. Replay all54 neural checkpoints and18 linear models; recompute weights/scales and all900 training-order hashes, source/input integrity, metrics, bootstrap tests and screens. Retain only the existing 141 validation dates.
